about: Each LOD step's settings (infra/gpu-box/lod.ps1 reads them on the machine), a section per save point: the long tool run ("tool") and our own pass over its output ("post"). A section is part of that save point's key (tools/newworld/world/lodkeys.py): change a setting, or raise rev when a change to that part of lod.ps1 changes what it writes, and only that part (and what stands on it) runs again. A change to a post section never reruns the tool.
